capturePolicy.views: All 49 reference views = 40 real routes + 9 reference-specific tab/selection states.
capturePolicy.baseCaptures: Every view at both themes and 1280x900 + 390x844 (196 view captures).
capturePolicy.shell: Additional shared-shell matrix below, both themes where meaningful.
capturePolicy.naming: qa/evidence/final/<theme>/<viewport>/<viewId>.png plus qa/final/json measurements; top/mid/bottom suffixes for scroll checks.
capturePolicy.noWrites: GET/read-only plus theme/appearance controls and non-submitting tab/search/select interactions only. No save, send, payment, credential, invite, approve, reverse, void or booking-create action.
capturePolicy.dynamicFixtures: Resolve memberId/batchId/enquiryId/staffId from the safe synthetic fixture DOM. Never hardcode a UUID.
capturePolicy.sourceSha: Final capture refuses to run unless --source-sha matches sourceReady.sha256.

unavailable.reason: No app/(owner) error.tsx exists in the baseline; a fabricated 500 or injected error is not acceptable evidence.
Reference explicitly says uploads are unavailable in this release; the honest unavailable state is the acceptance.
Reference is a design study, not a live integration; no provider is activated and no real message/payment is sent.
Seeded price rules are read-only for QA; if no seeded slot refuses, record NOT OBSERVED rather than mutating data.
Final run emulates 200% reflow with a 640x450 CSS viewport; browser UI zoom is not driven by Playwright.
Any capability shown only in the reference but absent from the real route is recorded as an explicit deviation, not invented.

notes: Run one bounded preview per routes/state/shell/permission/responsive group; the driver and owner_preview clean only owned descendants.

Raw production captures go to ignored .playwright-mcp/owner-openpen-final; do not copy anything into unignored docs between preview groups. Copy selected evidence only after ALL preview runs have exited, otherwise the budget-build fingerprint is invalidated.
Final capture refuses unless qa/final-matrix.json sourceReady.sha256 is set and --source-sha matches.
The reference input render is already ready and separate from final app review.
Every app record starts visualReviewed=false / visualVerdict=PENDING; independent review and human approval remain separate.
The final cp command must run only after every routes/states/shell/permission preview has exited; copying evidence between groups changes the source snapshot and invalidates the build receipt.

verdictPolicy.rule: Any visible hierarchy/spacing/overflow/reference mismatch can be CHANGES REQUIRED even when functional tests are green. Missing/unavailable state is UNTESTED or BLOCKED, never PASS.
